content: Thanks, Layla. What's the new brand? Type its name, or upload its Brand Profile and I'll fill it in for you to check.
A new brand needs both the Company Profile and the Brand Profile, even if you've sent them before. Upload them on the documents card.
I've filled the brand name and category from your Brand Profile. Please check them on the card.
Thanks. What's the brand name in Arabic?
Saved. Now upload the Company Profile on the documents card.
Your Company Profile shows a different company name from your Cenomi record. You can keep the record's name or tell me the right one.
Done, we'll keep your record's name, and the leasing team will see the difference. Check the review card and submit when you're ready.
Thanks, Layla. Your inquiry for Oasis Bakehouse is with the leasing team.
